title: I've Become a Noble
overview: Myne begins her new life as Rosemyne. Her first challenge is to complete the baptism and adoption ceremonies!

title: Lower City Family Reunion
overview: After the baptism ceremony and adoption, Rosemyne returns to the cathedral to become the high bishop.

title: Archduke's Castle and Italian Restaurant
overview: Rosemyne officially moves into the castle and Sylvester finally eats at the Italian restaurant.

title: How to Collect Donations
overview: Rosemyne tries to collect donations from the nobility, but finds it harder than she thought...

title: Concert Preparations
overview: Rosemyne puts all her efforts into preparing for the harspiel concert.

title: Harspiel Concert
overview: Everything is falling into place for the concert. All that's left is to guard against one person...

title: Hasse's Monastery
overview: The monastery in Hasse is now ready. Rosemyne goes for the final inspection and to accept new children.

title: Ferdinand's Task
overview: Ferdinand gives Rosemyne the task to entrap and isolate the mayor of Hasse.

title: Wilfried's Day as High Bishop
overview: Rosemyne finally gets fed up with Wilfried's complaints and offers to switch spots with him for a day.

title: The Gathering of Gutenbergs
overview: To improve the printing press, Ingo is even willing to exchange ideas between different trades.

title: The Winter Social Season and Debut
overview: The winter social season is here and Rosemyne must successfully finish her debut.

title: Winter Material Gathering
overview: Rosemyne attempts to gather materials for her jureve once again!

title: Hasse's Punishment
overview: Hasse's punishment has finally been decided and Rosemyne must go to witness the results.

title: Night of Fruhtrane
overview: Rosemyne must go to the Goddess's Bath on the Night of Fruhtrane to collect the spring material for her jureve.

title: New Dress and Printing Press
overview: Brigitte tries on the dress that Rosemyne designed while the printing press is finally ready for a test print.

title: Holding the Fort During the Archduke Conference
overview: With the archduke and his wife away, Rozemyne must stay at the castle with Wilfried.

title: Damuel's Proposal
overview: The Star-Binding Ceremony begins and Rosemyne hopes Brigitte's new dress will enchant the nobility.

title: Inspection of Illgner and Gathering of Summer
overview: Rosemyne and her Gutenberg go to Illgner in hopes of finding new materials for papermaking.

title: Georgine's Visit
overview: Georgine comes to visit and everyone in Ehrenfest question her true motives.
